categories.description: Select the archive operation. Most primary operations are mutually exclusive.
categories.name: Operation

options.detail: An existing archive at the output path is replaced. Named directories are archived recursively by default.
With no member names, extract all members. To select files, use their stored names. Extraction writes under the current directory by default and can replace existing files.
Supply stored member names to limit the listing. Add -v to see sizes, permissions and modification times.

options.summary: Compare archive members with filesystem files
options.detail: Checks contents and metadata against files with the same names on disk. Extra files on disk are ignored. Exit status 1 indicates differences.

options.detail: Quote the pattern so the shell passes it to tar unchanged. When creating an archive, put exclusions before the file names they apply to.
When reading a regular archive file, tar normally detects gzip automatically. Specify the method for compressed input from a pipe or non-seekable tape.
When reading a regular archive file, tar normally detects xz automatically. Specify the method for compressed input from a pipe or non-seekable tape.
When reading a regular archive file, tar normally detects bzip2 automatically. Specify the method for compressed input from a pipe or non-seekable tape.
With a listing, -v adds file metadata. During creation or extraction it shows member names.
